The [United Nations Editorial Manual Online](https://www.un.org/dgacm/en/content/editorial-manual) is the authoritative statement of the style to be followed in drafting, editing and reproducing UN documents. This site mirrors it **verbatim** in a form that AI assistants and agents can read reliably:

- Every page is also available as plain **Markdown**. Add `.md` to the page path, or use the "Markdown" link at the top of each page.
- [**`llms.txt`**](llms.txt) is an index of all pages, following the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention.
- [**`llms-full.txt`**](llms-full.txt) is the whole manual in one file, ready to attach to a chat or load into an agent.

## How it is made

- **Deterministic.** Pages are converted from un.org HTML by code. No AI rewrites the text.
- **Traceable.** Each page links to its un.org source and shows when its content last changed upstream.
- **Kept in sync.** A weekly job re-checks un.org, and changes are reviewed before publishing, alongside the manual's own [updates log](en/updates.md).
